$comment: Machine-readable record of what Humanity Ledger has deployed on Aztec testnet. Checked against the live node by .github/workflows/aztec-deployments.yml (test/live/aztec-deployments.live.test.ts). docs/AZTEC_TESTNET_DEPLOYMENTS.md is the human-readable version of this file. Entries with tracksCurrentArtifact=true must match the artifact committed today; older entries keep the class they were deployed with, which the live check still confirms on the node.

contracts.name: IdentityCredential
contracts.note: Deployed with placeholder roots (identity 0x12345678, sanctions 0x87654321): no member can claim until the issuer sets a real identity root. Its class predates the expiry bound (SEC-I7) and the root guard of 5 Nov 2026.

contracts.name: PrivateEscrow
contracts.note: Deployed without public keys. Tokens deposited here become notes owned by a contract that has no nullifier key, so no PXE can ever spend them: deposits would be locked. Escrows must use a keyed instance (scripts/aztec/deploy-keyed.ts).

contracts.name: PaymentStream
contracts.note: Deployed without public keys; same consequence as the PrivateEscrow instance above. Streams must use a keyed instance.

contracts.name: PrivateEscrow v1 (keyed, end-to-end run)
contracts.note: Deployed by the workflow 'Aztec escrow e2e (testnet)', run 41865790651: keyed universal deployment, deposit (tx 0x10700502…5f13, block 18445) and claim (tx 0x10fb36c0…23f2, block 18447). Custodies a throwaway test token; settled. Shows the per-agreement pattern with the first PrivateEscrow class (before the deposit-expiration fix); not an instance for new deposits.

contracts.name: PrivateEscrow v2 (keyed, end-to-end run)
contracts.note: Current PrivateEscrow class (deposit expiration bounded by the deadline), published with this deployment. Workflow 'Aztec escrow e2e (testnet)' run 41881180186: one escrow claimed, one refunded after its deadline; empty afterwards. A reference instance, not one for new deposits: each agreement gets its own keyed instance. Superseded on 5 Nov 2026 by the class with escrow_view (AZ-21).

contracts.name: PaymentStream v2 (keyed, end-to-end run)
contracts.note: Current PaymentStream class (overflow-free accrual, no self-streams), published with this deployment. Run 41881180186: stream of 20 test tokens created, 5 withdrawn within accrual. A reference instance, not one for new streams. Superseded on 5 Nov 2026 by the class with sender cancel (SEC-S12).

contracts.name: PaymentStream v3 (keyed, end-to-end run)
contracts.note: Class with sender cancel (SEC-S12). Run 41999587163: deployed in block 19342; two streams; withdrawal within accrual, cancel by the sender (block 19352), withdrawal after the cancel rejected by the node ('Existing nullifier'). Stream 2 (5 test tokens) stays locked: the run's keys were discarded. Superseded on 5 Nov 2026 by the class with stream_view (SEC-S13).

contracts.name: IdentityCredential v2 (end-to-end run)
contracts.note: Class with the expiry bound (SEC-I7) and the root guard. Run 41999587163: deployed with a placeholder root (block 19355); the throwaway issuer published a real depth-32 root (block 19356); a member claimed in scope 1 (block 19358); a second claim in the same scope and a root change by a non-issuer were refused. Superseded on 5 Nov 2026 by the class with the root grace period (SEC-I8) and issuer rotation (SEC-I9).

contracts.name: IdentityCredential v3 (end-to-end run)
contracts.note: Class with the root grace period (SEC-I8) and two-step issuer rotation (SEC-I9). Run 42023143254: deployed with a placeholder root (block 19525, tx 0x0ca97aeb5b781274820b35e41c92c36bd02ac6d8ded9149c673ba82df1635e2f); the issuer published a real depth-32 root (19528); a member claimed in scope 1 (19530); the issuer replaced the root (19532) and a claim against the replaced root landed within the grace period (19534); the issuer proposed (19535) and the new issuer accepted (19537); the previous issuer was then refused.

contracts.name: PrivateEscrow v3 (keyed, end-to-end run)
contracts.note: Class with escrow_view (AZ-21). Run 42030688268: keyed deploy that published the class (block 19563, tx 0x1bb4b2696fa3cbbcd6ffea65d35b88c653307d262aeb6765fb8c5318ec8620c2); escrow 1 deposit (19564), escrow_view read by both parties, claim (19568), the sender's view then reports it settled; escrow 2 deposit (19566), claim after the deadline refused, refund (19577). Both escrows settled; nothing left in the instance.

contracts.name: PaymentStream v4 (keyed, end-to-end run)
contracts.note: Class with stream_view (SEC-S13). Run 42030688268: keyed deploy that published the class (block 19570, tx 0x274acaf9bc287080495267f0352b9a56dfe01737a79dc42a8ad7736e88f9a0c9); stream 1 (19571) and stream 2 (19573); withdraw 5 (19575), after which stream_view gave the sender the live state at index 1, not its stale copy; cancel (19580), after which the recipient's view shows the stream not live. Stream 2 (5 test tokens) remains in the instance.

contracts.name: PrivateEscrow v3, agreement opened with openEscrow (end-to-end run)
contracts.note: Run 42030688268: deployed by openEscrow (block 19594, tx 0x13b184c657e37f667bf18d84d7e89762e463c650e45dde1051a84bbd12280c8a), deposit of 3 (19595); acceptInvite refused a tampered invitation and registered the genuine one; confirmAgreement found every field equal to the stored note and an overstated amount was caught; the recipient claimed (19597).
